name: Carafe
description: A counter restaurant and wine bar set like a printed menu card: a real menu with leaders and aligned prices, kitchen and bar hours kept apart, and a booking enquiry that says it is not connected.
designNotes: Plotform adaptation of AstroWind, not an unchanged upstream template.
No photographs anywhere: the identity is the type, a claret accent, hairline and dotted rules, a paper ground made of CSS gradients, and five drawings written as SVG for this edition.
The menu is the point: sections, a one line description for every item, leaders, and a price column that keeps one right edge from 1440 down to 320, in tabular figures.
Prices are illustrative sample values invented for the template, and the menu, the wine list, the credits and the foot of every page say so.
Kitchen and bar hours are separate lists, Monday is closed in both, and a note covers public holidays. Today's row is marked from the day numbers on the rows themselves.
Booking is a mailto link beside a form with no action that says plainly that nothing is sent.
Set in Playfair Display for display and Source Serif 4 for reading, both bundled locally with their OFL files. No monospace.
